name: Lori Chavez-DeRemer
summary:
Lori Michelle Chavez-DeRemer (; née  Chavez; born April 7, 1968) is an American politician and businesswoman who served as the United States secretary of labor from 2025 until her resignation in 2026. A member of the Republican Party, Chavez-DeRemer served as the U.S. representative for Oregon's fifth congressional district from 2023 to 2025 and as the mayor of Happy Valley, Oregon, from 2011 to 2019.
Chavez-DeRemer graduated from California State University, Fresno, with a Bachelor of Business Administration in 1990.
